Listen to all phenomena, trace the flow of causality, and guide chaos toward the one true answer.

Passive
[Passive - Slot Bound] Universal Empowerment: When Raphael is bound to an active slot, it strengthens the holder in many ways. Improves movement, attack speed, casting speed, dodging ability, learning speed, mastery gain, presence sensing, and rewards gained from defeating enemies. After mastery, these bonuses become stronger. All bonuses only apply while Raphael is active.

Active
[Active - Press] Analytical Appraisal: Displays information about nearby targets. The display can be switched between entities only, blocks only, or both entities and blocks. No Magicule cost. No cooldown.

[Active - Press] Analysis: Allows Raphael to analyze and copy skills from other sources. If the holder is looking at a projectile carrying a magic skill, Raphael attempts to copy that magic first. If there is no valid projectile, Raphael instead analyzes a nearby living target and attempts to copy one of their learned skills. The original owner does not lose their skill. Some powerful, protected, or special skills cannot be copied. After mastery, Analysis becomes much more reliable and easier to use.

[Active - Press] Refine: Opens Raphael's refining functions. This mode can be used for refining items or repeating previous crafting actions, inheriting the functions of Great Sage.

[Active - Press] Crafting: Opens Raphael's crafting-related functions. This mode can be used for crafting and uncrafting, inheriting the functions of Great Sage.

[Active - Press] Synthesise: Opens the synthesis interface. Synthesis allows the holder to combine two items into a new result, inheriting the power of Degenerate. After mastery, Synthesise becomes cheaper and has a shorter cooldown.

[Active - Press] Separate: Opens the separation interface. Separation allows the holder to break down certain combined items back into their original parts, inheriting the power of Degenerate. After mastery, Separate becomes cheaper and has a shorter cooldown.

Server Rules
Unique Raphael: By default, only one player on a server can own Raphael at a time. If another player already has Raphael, fusion will not happen. The server can disable this limit, allowing multiple players to own Raphael at the same time.

Notes
Raphael is the completed form of Great Sage and Degenerate. It combines analysis, appraisal, crafting, refinement, synthesis, and separation into one Ultimate Skill. Its core strength is not raw destruction, but understanding, calculation, and control.

With an invisible oath as the ring, the faith of many is gathered into one, becoming a silent and insurmountable order.

Acquisition
Evolves through Raphael, Lord of Wisdom's Synthesis mode.
Prerequisite: mastered Infinity Prison.

Passive
[Passive - Always Active] Capacity Expansion: Permanently increases water capacity by 30 and lava capacity by 20.

[Passive - Always Active] Spatial Bonus: Permanently increases Spatial Bonus by +0.5.

[Passive - Slot Bound] Oath Guardian: When Uriel is bound to any active slot, any damage from an attacker whose max Existence Value is lower than the holder's max Existence Value x1.5 is absorbed by Magicules instead. After mastery, the threshold becomes x2.25. Each 1 HP of damage consumes 8 MP. After mastery, efficiency is improved by x0.7.

Active
[Active - Press] Imprisonment: Targets a single living entity within 12 blocks. Consumes 800 MP. Fails if the target's max Existence Value is greater than the holder's max Existence Value x1.0. After mastery, this limit becomes x1.5. Default duration is 200 ticks, 10 seconds. Mastered duration is 300 ticks, 15 seconds. Cooldown is 200 ticks, or 140 ticks when mastered. If no target is found and the skill fails, the cooldown is halved.

[Active - Press] Imaginary Space: Opens Uriel's exclusive imaginary storage with 90 slots and a stack limit of 999. No Magicule cost. No cooldown.

[Active - Press] Abnormality Cleanse: Removes negative effects and magical interference from the user. Shift + Press changes the target to an entity within 8 blocks. Cooldown is 60 ticks, or 42 ticks when mastered. No Magicule cost. Successfully cleansing effects increases proficiency.

[Active - Press] Law Seizure: Unlocked only after mastery and skipped during mode switching if not mastered. Targets enemy magical projectiles within 32 blocks and seizes their ownership. If the target is a magic circle instead, it is destroyed, and the original caster's corresponding skill is forcibly placed on cooldown for 600 ticks, or 900 ticks after mastery. Fails if the projectile owner's max Existence Value is greater than or equal to the holder's max Existence Value x1.0. Cooldown is 100 ticks, or 70 ticks when mastered.

[Active - Press] Multi-Layer Barrier: On press, sets the holder's Barrier Points to max HP x4.5, or x6.75 after mastery. Press again to deactivate. Damage below the barrier value is offset using MP through the holder's existing barrier attributes. Shift + Press applies the barrier to an ally within 5 blocks: max HP x3.0, or x4.5 after mastery. Allies who already have Uriel's barrier cannot receive another one. Consumes 300 MP. Cooldown is 80 ticks, or 56 ticks when mastered.

[Active - Hold] Dimensional Ray: Consumes 15 MP per tick. Fires a 24-block-long beam, dealing 8 damage per tick. After mastery, damage increases to 12 per tick. Maximum duration is 60 ticks, 3 seconds. Cooldown after ending is 120 ticks, or 84 ticks when mastered. Proficiency continuously increases while holding.

[Active - Press] Dimensional Storm: Consumes 600 MP. Summons 12 spatial rays converging on the target entity within 32 blocks, or 24 rays after mastery. If there is no target, the rays converge on the point the user is looking at. Each ray deals 25 damage, or 37.5 after mastery. The impact points deal area damage within a 10-block radius. Cooldown is 200 ticks, or 140 ticks when mastered.

Command storms and thunder, suppressing the battlefield with sustained wind blades, black lightning, and a moving Storm Domain.

All numbers below are defaults and may be changed by the server.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Storm Domination: Increases wind elemental damage by 50% and lightning elemental damage by 60%.
[Passive - In Slot] Wind and Lightning Protection: Reduces incoming wind and lightning elemental damage by 80%.
[Passive - In Slot] Storm Guard: When hit by a close-range attack, has a 20% chance to knock the attacker back with wind pressure.

Active
[Active - Hold] Storm Breath: Continuously releases lightning breath and wind pressure ahead of the user. Range: 24 blocks. Base damage: 28, or 40 when mastered. Costs 350 Magicules per second, or 200 when mastered; cooldown after release: 3 seconds. Reduced wind pressure helps keep enemies within attack range.

[Active - Press] Storm Lightning: Releases black lightning at the aimed location. Range: 30 blocks; impact radius: 4 blocks. Primary damage: 80, or 120 when mastered, plus secondary magic damage equal to 25% of primary damage. Costs 2,000 Magicules, or 1,000 when mastered. Cooldown: 6 seconds, or 5 when mastered.

[Active - Press] Storm Domain: Creates a spherical domain that follows the user. Radius: 24 blocks, or 32 when mastered. Duration: 30 seconds. Cooldown: 120 seconds, or 90 when mastered, starting upon activation.
The domain selects the nearest visible enemies within range, with up to 8 targets per volley. Eligible enemies include hostile monsters, creatures attacking the user, and attackable non-allied players when server PvP is enabled. Livestock and pets are no longer selected for random lightning strikes. Wind blades still follow projectile collision rules.
The opening volley deals 55 primary and 18 secondary damage to each selected enemy. Each domain lightning bolt makes one damage attempt against its designated target only; overlapping impacts and repeated thunder hits do not multiply damage. Movement Interference and light knockback are applied every 0.5 seconds; wind blades with 24 base damage fire every second. Every 2 seconds, skill black lightning strikes up to 3 enemies for 35 primary and 10 secondary damage. The domain creates thunderstorm weather and restores the previous weather when it ends.
Activation costs the higher of 10,000 Magicules (6,000 when mastered) and 3% of maximum Magicules. Upkeep costs another 0.3% of maximum Magicules per second. Costs are deducted from current Magicules; insufficient energy ends the domain early.

[Active - Hold] Storm Black Magic Slash: Hold a sword in the main hand and keep the skill key pressed. After approximately 0.9 seconds of preparation, continuously release a storm-black-mist slash. Default beam length: 36 blocks; maximum total hold time: 10 seconds. Deals 65 primary damage, or 95 when mastered, every 0.5 seconds, plus 25% secondary lightning damage. Costs 2,300 Magicules (1,200 when mastered) when the beam activates and every following second. Cooldown when the attack ends or is cancelled: 4 seconds, or 2 when mastered. Releasing or being interrupted during preparation also starts this cooldown.
The user remains stationary but may aim within 35 degrees of the initial direction, and gains 30% additional incoming damage reduction while casting, except against special damage that bypasses invulnerability. Light hits no longer interrupt immediately: post-reduction damage accumulated within one second must reach 10% of maximum health to interrupt. Paralysis, petrification, sleep, releasing the skill key, or no longer holding a sword also interrupts the attack.

Balance Update
Wind and lightning damage reduction increased from 35% to 80%; breath and lightning damage and breath range increased. The domain has a shorter cooldown, stronger and more frequent wind blades, reliable skill black lightning in place of random vanilla lightning, improved target selection, target limits, and ongoing Magicule upkeep. Black Magic Slash now allows limited aiming and protects against minor interruptions.
